order.body: When a customer asks for goods, create an order. Paste their WhatsApp message and Munshi AI fills in the items for you.

order.meaning: What a customer asked for. Not billed yet.

chat.welcomeTitle: Namaste! Ask me anything about your business
chat.welcomeBody: Sales, stock, dues, profit, GST, staff — or how to do something in SethSathi. Type or tap the mic to speak.
suggestions: How much did I sell today?
Who owes me the most money?
Compare this month's sales with last month
What is my profit this month?
How much GST do I have to pay this month?
chat.tooShort: That was too short — hold on a little longer while you speak.
chat.disclaimer: Munshi AI answers from your SethSathi data. It only proposes changes — you confirm them.

hub.intro: Simple business reports from your real bills, purchases and stock. Pick a report and a period; download any table for Excel or your CA.

help.sales: How much you sold, how much came in, and your best products and customers.
help.purchases: What you bought and from whom.
help.profit: Estimated gross profit: sales (before GST) minus the cost of goods sold.
help.stock: What your stock is worth, what's running low, and what isn't selling.
help.dues: Who owes you money, and who you owe — as of today.
help.gst: GST on your GST bills vs GST paid on purchases. Use it to prepare GSTR-3B with your CA.

profit.note: This is an estimate: it uses each product's current cost price and doesn't include expenses like rent or salaries.

gst.note: Only bills made as “GST bill” are counted on the sales side. This is a helper — please confirm figures with your CA before filing.

businessSettings.saved: Saved. New bills will show these details.

businessSettings.detailsBody: Printed at the top of every bill.
businessSettings.addressHint: Shop no., market, city, PIN — as you want it on bills.
businessSettings.stateHint: Used to decide CGST + SGST or IGST on GST bills.
businessSettings.gstBody: Add your GSTIN to print it on GST bills. Leave empty if you're not registered — you can still make simple bills.
businessSettings.gstinHint: 15 characters, e.g. 27ABCDE1234F1Z5. Your state is picked from the first two digits.
businessSettings.gstinInvalid: This doesn't look like a GSTIN. Check it on your GST certificate.
businessSettings.howGst1: Each item's GST rate comes from the item (Inventory → edit item). HSN code is printed too.
businessSettings.howGst2: Customer in your state → CGST + SGST (half each). Customer in another state (by their GSTIN or state) → IGST.
businessSettings.howGst3: Discounts are taken off before GST. The total is rounded to the nearest rupee and the round-off is shown.
businessSettings.howGst4: Simple bills add no GST — use them for cash sales that don't need a tax invoice.
businessSettings.billBody: Add your UPI ID and a QR code prints on every bill with money due. Customers scan and pay the exact amount.
businessSettings.upiHint: Find it in GPay / PhonePe / Paytm → profile, e.g. shopname@okicici.
businessSettings.upiInvalid: A UPI ID looks like name@bank.
businessSettings.terms: Terms at the bottom of the bill

businessSettings.termsPlaceholder: Goods once sold will not be taken back. Subject to local jurisdiction.
